pr_body:
A [recent change](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/102207) improved a remaining disk estimation during desired balance computation. This caused this test failure due to the unrealistic setup.

The test was generating non-empty shards unassigned with a recovery source that only supports empty shards.

Closes: #104343

review_comment:
This previously generated not empty unassigned shards with either:
* EmptyStoreRecoverySource that does not reduce remaining disk space as it expects the shard is empty
* ExistingStoreRecoverySource that does not reduce remaining disk space as it expects the shard data is already on disk

This is fixed by always relying on ExistingStoreRecoverySource and reserving extra disk space on the node with `lastAllocatedNodeId` for the existing shard data.
We really should think about getting all these overloads under control :)
I have something in mind, going to open a pr with it today or tomorrow
